data.action: 指尖弹出硬币，电光贯穿夜空
data.description: 【御坂美琴 · 电光战场】被刺目雷光彻底照亮的夜间高架桥上，狂暴的十亿伏特高压电流撕裂黑暗。美琴大拇指将一枚游戏机特制硬币高高弹向夜空，橙红色的超电磁炮光束贯穿虚空轰然爆发——「敢在我的面前伤害无辜的人……做好被电成焦炭的觉悟了吗？超电磁炮（Railgun）——！」
data.promptProse: Misaka Mikoto flicks a game-center coin upward with her thumb on the broken night overpass, fierce eyes following its spin before the railgun discharge. Her Tokiwadai blouse, vest and beige skirt retain the action silhouette. The dynamic view follows the orange-red beam across the dark bridge. Blue-white lightning outlines her raised hand and metal rail, while the railgun flash illuminates fractured paving in an instant, casting stark shadows behind broken edges.
data.title: 御坂美琴 · 电光战场
